run_make_changelog: run the make_changelog script to extract changelog entries from closed GitHub issues labeled needs changelog
extract_changelog_entries: extract RST-formatted changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the ENTRY regex pattern
list_issues_needing_changelog: list closed GitHub issues with the needs changelog label for the pybind11 repository
report_missing_changelog: report GitHub issues that are missing a suggested changelog entry in their body
display_changelog_template: display the suggested changelog entry template in RST format for contributors to use
